attempts.answer:
The Garchomp, Kingambit and Gholdengo core covers most matchups. Mega Garchomp and Black Glasses Kingambit give raw power, and Choice Scarf Gholdengo adds speed control and can Trick its scarf onto passive walls. Lum Berry Dragonite and Sitrus Berry Volcarona are the two setup sweepers, so every bring-3 can carry one. Leftovers Rotom-Wash pivots with Volt Switch and burns physical threats with Will-O-Wisp, which keeps the setup threats safe.
